description: Paris 10e: Rue du 8 Mai 1945 also carries name:zh 1945年5月8日街, one word whose first integer is 1945. The token 1945 reads that name as the street (no other words), and its house refs take the tokens 13 and 8 from the French name 'mai 1945 8 du rue' (4 other words found), because addAtom preferred the shorter entry. The street is then named by 1945 alone, 8 becomes a second house and the query falls apart; the same address in Drancy (associatedStreet relation 'Rue du 8 Mai 1945' with ways 'Rue du Huit Mai 1945') and Chaville, without name:zh, wins 8-14 km away. The extract carries the named streets of the 10e (two nodes each) so that mai stays an indexed word as on the full map (309 matched, 277 indexed) and the top 10 frequent words are rue, de, du, passage, des.
